factor.name: ORBIT-SOFT fixed group-projection regularization

factor.state_matching: B/U16,D64,H16 posterior values, explicitly disclosed; no matched effect claimed.
factor.parameter_matching: B/U1904,D16784,H256; H and D not parameter-matched, declared diagnostic roles.
factor.executed_compute_matching: Record all update/token/time costs; no effect matching verdict in this control pilot.
factor.prior_art_boundary: Soft equivariance/RPP and exact HMM filtering are established. This pilot measures control learning and diagnostic headroom, not a candidate effect, novelty, semantics or Gate1.
